cases.title: Blessed bat bones
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Blessed bat bones''' are the blessed form of [[bat bones]] obtained by using them on the [[exposed altar]] on the summit of [[Ralos' Rise]]. They are broken down with a [[chisel]] to obtain 5 [[blessed bone shards]] and 5 [[Crafting]] experience, which can then be sacrificed at the [[libation bowl]] at [[the Teomat]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Blessed bat bones detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Blessed bat bones''' are the blessed form of [[bat bones]] obtained by using them on the [[exposed altar]] on the summit of [[Ralos' Rise]]. They are broken down with a [[chisel]] to obtain 5 [[blessed bone shards]] and 5 [[Crafting]] experience, which can then be sacrificed at the [[libation bowl]] at [[the Teomat]].

As each shard sacrificed gives 5 [[Prayer]] experience, each blessed bone gives 25 Prayer experience overall. If using a [[jug of blessed sunfire wine]] at the libation bowl instead of a regular [[jug of blessed wine]], this is increased to 6 Prayer experience per shard, or 30 Prayer experience per bone.

Players looking to bless bones in bulk may talk to [[Virilis]], found at the base of the exposed altar, to unnote any type of [[bones]] for a fee of 10 [[coins]] per bone.

Breaking-down these bones under the correct conditions will give a [[Token (Varlamore)|red token]]; when the player receives one, a game message will state {{mes|You find a small token while breaking down bones.}}

cases.title: Chugging barrel
cases.semanticExcerpt: The '''chugging barrel''' is a tradeable item that allows players to consume up to five potions in a single click. It is purchased from the [[Mixology Rewards]] shop at a cost of  17,250 [[Mox resin]], 14,000 [[Aga resin]], and 18,600 [[Lye resin]]. It is sold in a disassembled state (where it cannot store potions); players must use the 'Assemble' option in order for the barrel to become useable. The player is not required to have done the [[Mastering Mixology]] mini-game to assemble it. The barrel is only tradeable in its disassembled state.  While the assembled barrel is untradeable, it is possible to dismantle the barrel at any time, although doing so will cause all potions currently stored inside to be lost.
secondaryExcerpts: The barrel can be filled by using up to five different potions on the item itself or via the bank loadout interface; a maximum of 100 doses per potion can be stored. Players can set up to four different loadouts in a bank for the barrel, as well as reorder the potions consumed, filling, and emptying the barrel. Potions and [[Potions#Barbarian_Mixes|barbarian mixes]] can be stored, but [[Hunter's mix|hunter mixes]] cannot. Reordering potions allows players to consume potions in a specific order, such as [[Saradomin brew]]s before [[super restore]]s, allowing for stats to be boosted correctly. Vials will not be consumed after using all the contents inside the vial. When loading from presets, the barrel will pull from whichever interface is opened (i.e, if looking at potion storage when loading, the barrel will pull potions from pot storage). While it may be beneficial for certain players to place their [[super attack]], [[Super strength|strength]], and [[Super defence|defence]] potions inside the barrel and drink it as if it were a [[super combat potion]], it is recommended to buy super combat potions since they are cheaper than the barrel.

'''The barrel may only be used within a [[bank]] or next to a [[bank chest]].''' Certain bank interfaces do not allow the use of the barrel.{{Fact|Some were fixed on 12 August 2026, are there any banks where it still doesn't work?}}

[[Ultimate Ironmen]] are able to store potion doses inside the chugging barrel and consume potions from it. However, they cannot set loadouts as it requires the use of a bank interface to do so. Its contents are also preserved even when the barrel is lost or deleted on death, able to be accessed after assembling a new chugging barrel. This allows it to be used for [[ghost storage]], although due to the time investment to reobtain the barrel, this is not very useful.

<gallery mode="packed" heights="200" style="text-align:left">
Chugging barrel interface.png|The chugging barrel's interface when opened.
Chugging barrel - potion load-out interface.png|The configuration interface in the bank.
Drinking chugging barrel.gif|Chugging the barrel.
Mastering Mixology - rewards concept art.png|Concept art of various mixology rewards, by [[Mod Jerv]].
</gallery>

Up to five potion types,100doses each,four bank loadouts; no hunter mixes, dismantling loses contents, UIM cannot set bank loadouts and retains contents on loss/death. Acquisition at Mixology does not limit ordinary use; bank/chest-use restriction preserved.

cases.title: Giant Squirrel
cases.semanticExcerpt: The '''giant squirrel''' is a skilling [[pet]] that can be obtained after completion of an [[Agility course]], as well as from tagging marked ticket dispensers within the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]].
secondaryExcerpts: If a player's inventory is full '''and''' they have a follower already, they '''will not''' receive the pet; it must instead be claimed from [[Probita]] in [[East Ardougne]].
The xp rates used in this graph are nearly the highest, if not the highest, possible that can be obtained at each course. The time to receive the pet assumes the player has 99 Agility.

[[File:Giant squirrel (Christmas 2016) pet.png|thumb|right|110px|The giant squirrel during Christmas 2016.]]
*The giant squirrel's appearance is based on the {{WP|Indian giant squirrel}} in real life.
*The second and third dialogues are a reference to the episode "Squirrel Jokes" from the {{Wp|Nickelodeon}} cartoon ''{{Wp|SpongeBob SquarePants}}''.
*The second dialogue might also be a reference to "Squirrel Songs" by Foamy the Squirrel.

cases.title: Alan's bones
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Alan's bones''' are the [[remains]] of what was once [[Alan (Scrambled!)|Alan the tourist]], which are obtainable after the completion of the [[Scrambled!]] [[quest]].
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Alan's bones detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Alan's bones''' are the [[remains]] of what was once [[Alan (Scrambled!)|Alan the tourist]], which are obtainable after the completion of the [[Scrambled!]] [[quest]].

There are a number of unique interactions with Alan's bones:
* Can be blessed at the [[exposed altar]] to turn them into [[Alan's blessed bones]]
* Can be given to [[Sheepdog#Rosie|Rosie]] at the [[South Falador farm]], [[Floki]] north of [[Land's End]], [[Molossus]], [[Lola]], and [[Xolo]] in [[Varlamore]], or [[Stray dog|stray dogs]] in [[Varrock]]. Doing so yields the chat messages {{mes|You give the dog Alan's bones.}} followed by {{mes|It happily gnaws on them, but something feels wrong about all of this.}}
* Can be used to distract [[Gus#Dog (alert)|the dog]] in [[The Final Dawn]]. Doing so yields the message "''The dog takes Alan's bones. Something doesn't feel quite right about this, but the dog seems happy enough. He quickly calms down and gives your hand a little lick.''"
* Can be crushed using the [[bone grinder]] into [[Alan's bonemeal]].
* Can be fed to your [[puppy]] after completing [[A Ruff Situation]]. Doing so brings up a chat interface with the message "''Are you sure you wish to feed your puppy alan's bones?''" followed by a No or Yes selection. Selecting no yields a chat message "''It would feel wrong to do so''". Selecting yes yields a chat interface message "''You feed your puppy alan's bones. Something feels wrong about all of this.''"

Should the player be in possession of the [[Bonecrusher]] or [[Bonecrusher necklace|its necklace variant]] at the time of [[Quests|quest]] completion, the bones will be automatically buried; It is important to make sure neither of these items are on their person as Alan dies, should the player desire to keep them.

cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Blessed strykewyrm bones detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Blessed strykewyrm bones''' are the blessed form of [[strykewyrm bones]] obtained by using them on the [[exposed altar]] on the summit of [[Ralos' Rise]]. '''Barracuda paint''' is a type of [[boat paint]] used to recolour the trim of a player's [[skiff]] or [[sloop]] via the [[boat schematics]] board at the [[Shipyard]]. Trimming a boat requires level 25 [[Sailing]] and 20 [[Construction]], granting 10 Construction experience. One paint is required for trimming skiffs, while sloops require two.

Barracuda paint is received randomly from Marlin rank [[Barracuda Trial]]s with the following rates, but only if the target time is achieved.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/sailing-xp-review--further-fixes?oldschool=1|title=Sailing XP Review & Further Fixes|newsdate=3 December 2025}} The expected time to obtain a paint in the table below assumes the player always reaches the target time:

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Barracuda Trial !! Rate !! Expected time
|-
| [[The Tempor Tantrum]] || 1/240 || {{#expr:1/((3600/270)*(1/240))}} hours
|-
| [[The Jubbly Jive]] || 1/220 || {{#expr:floor(1/((3600/321)*(1/220)))}} hours {{#expr:(1/((3600/321)*(1/220)) fmod 1)*60 round 0 }} minutes
|-

cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Marlin scales detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Marlin scales''' is a [[Herblore secondaries|Herblore secondary]] used to make [[extended stamina potion]]s, requiring one scale per dose. It can be obtained by using a knife on a [[raw marlin]] from [[deep sea trawling]], yielding three scales per marlin upon success, whose chance scales with the player's [[Cooking]] level.

If cutting on a [[chum facility]], players will receive scales equal to three times the number of marlin cut on that tick, assuming a successful cut. For example, a [[chum spreader]] can cut 4 marlins per tick, yielding a potential 12 marlin scales per tick.

cases.title: Fish crate (empty)
cases.semanticExcerpt: '''Empty fish crates''' are an item made by using a [[camphor crate]] with an [[ice cooler]], which are purchased from [[Slayer Master]]s; up to 10 can be made per action. They are used to store raw fish obtained from shoals whilst [[deep sea trawling]]; deep sea fish can only be stored within the crate in sets of 10.
cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Fish crate (empty) detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Empty fish crates''' are an item made by using a [[camphor crate]] with an [[ice cooler]], which are purchased from [[Slayer Master]]s; up to 10 can be made per action. They are used to store raw fish obtained from shoals whilst [[deep sea trawling]]; deep sea fish can only be stored within the crate in sets of 10.

Empty fish crates are stackable when empty, allowing them to only take one space in the [[cargo hold]] of a [[boat]]. When emptying a trawling net into the cargo hold with empty fish crates stored inside, the crates will automatically be filled, with any remainders stored as normal. As each crate can store 10 fish, players can effectively store up to 10 times the cargo hold's capacity in fish by storing crates filled with fish, which can drastically lengthen a trawling trip.

Filled fish crates can only be emptied while standing inside a bank, returning the crate without the ice cooler. This must be done by  right-clicking the "Empty" option whilst having a banking interface open; if emptying the fish crate otherwise, the crate will be '''lost'''.

A '''crate of arrowtips''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. A '''crate of arrowtips''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of fish''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of gems''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of gems''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of gems''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Crate of feathers detail.png|150px|left]]
A '''crate of feathers''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of logs''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of logs''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. A '''crate of coal''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of coal''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

A '''crate of coal''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Crate of dragonhide detail.png|150px|left]]
A '''crate of dragonhide''' is an item that may be obtained from a [[ledger table]] after taking on a [[courier task]], which must then be delivered to the corresponding destination's port by boarding their [[boat]] and sailing to said destination. Players without a crewmate to navigate their boat must store the crate in the [[cargo hold]] before they can man the helm.

Multiple of a crate may be required to be delivered for a courier task, in which case players must board their boat multiple times to store the crates (as they can only carry one at a time) or have a [[crewmate]] assist them, who will automatically take a crate when the player does so. While any crewmate can carry a crate, those with Deckhandiness levels of at least 3 can carry two at once.

Players cannot unequip the crate normally, nor can they teleport or leave the port area with the crate equipped. If the player leaves the area, a game message appears stating {{mes|You're leaving port with some cargo. If you do not return it, it will be confiscated by the shipwright wizard's autonomous tracking unit.|colour=#ff3045}} After 22 ticks (13.2s), the crate will be removed with an accompanying game message stating {{mes|Your cargo has been confiscated by the S.W.A.T. team.|colour=#ff0000}}

cases.positiveFunctionExcerpt:
[[File:Rosewood logs detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Rosewood logs''' are logs which can be cut from [[rosewood tree]]s, requiring 92 [[Woodcutting]] to chop and grants 212.5 Woodcutting [[experience]] per log. Players can burn these logs with the [[Firemaking]] skill for 268 experience at level 92 or above.

Players training [[Construction]] can bring rosewood logs to a [[sawmill]] to get a [[rosewood plank]] at a cost of 7,500 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the [[Lunar spell]] [[Plank Make]] can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of [[runes]]. 

[[Rosewood tree]]s are only located on [[Drumstick Isle]], which requires level 79 [[Sailing]] to dock at. Players with level 92 [[Farming]] can also [[Rosewood tree (Farming)|farm them]] by planting a [[rosewood sapling]] at a [[hardwood tree patch]].

Because Drumstick Isle is far from a bank, having a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|greater teleport focus]] is recommended to chop large quantities, although this can be rather costly and/or even more time-consuming to obtain. Without the greater teleport focus, using the [[Prifddinas dock]] and sailing north to the teal portal is the fastest way to get to the isle. A [[log basket]] is recommended to extend trip lengths, and if intending to make planks out of the logs, a [[plank sack]] with runes and coins for [[Plank Make]], as well as [[sawmill voucher]]s is a further optimisation.
